worked_rank_computations.proof: Each of the seven disjoint nonempty rows owns at least one K value; a seven-column submatrix is I_7. The 7 grouped probabilities sum to one, so only 6 are free; 51-state within-band detail is not identified.

worked_rank_computations.component: U.S. House popular-vote margin (v2 market IDs 1395450–1395462; explicit Other sibling outside v2)
worked_rank_computations.proof: The 13 market Yes indicators select 13 mutually exclusive signed-margin bins; the Other sibling is the residual. The 13x13 selected-bin block is I_13. The partition resolves the national margin distribution, not any individual House district winner.

worked_rank_computations.component: Georgia Senate x Governor joint outcomes (v2 IDs 3729337–3729340; explicit Other sibling outside v2)
worked_rank_computations.proof: The four rows select four cells of the 3x3 D/R/Other fine state table. Adding normalization makes rank 5; four of the eight simplex dimensions are observed and four remain in the five fine states pooled into Other. At the coarsened 5-category event-group level (four cells plus Other), the four Yes probabilities determine the Other residual.

worked_rank_computations.component: U.S. Senate x House seat count (13 market IDs 2683257–2683269)
worked_rank_computations.proof: The 13 disjoint coarsened categories cover all 16 finer count-band cells; one row sums the two lowest House bands for Senate >=53, and two rows sum the top House bands for Senate <=46 and 47–49. The category rows partition the fine state space (row sum equals normalization), so grouped probabilities have 12 free dimensions while three within-group dimensions are lost.
